'use client'
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import {
  LogOut, LayoutDashboard, ChevronDown, Menu, X,
  Zap, Settings, BookOpen, TrendingUp, Shield, Search, HelpCircle,
  Bookmark, Award, ClipboardList, Sparkles,
  Target, Radar, Map, LifeBuoy, Share2,
} from 'lucide-react'
import ThemeToggle from './ThemeToggle'
import SearchModal from './SearchModal'
import NotificationBell from './NotificationBell'
import { openOnboardingWizard } from './OnboardingWizard'
import { getFeaturesByCategory, type FeatureCategory } from '../lib/featuresCatalog'
import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from './ui/Avatar'

// Icons for the Tools mega-menu tabs. lib/featuresCatalog.ts's
// FEATURE_CATEGORIES only defines `label` (no icon field), so these are
// chosen here to visually represent each category; the labels themselves
// still come straight from the catalog so they can't drift.
const CATEGORY_ICONS: Record<FeatureCategory, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
  assess: Target,
  monitor: Radar,
  plan: Map,
  protect: LifeBuoy,
  connect: Share2,
  corporate: Shield,
}

type SessionUser = {
  id: string
  email: string
  name?: string | null
  avatar?: string | null
  provider?: string
}

function Avatar({ user, size = 32 }: { user: SessionUser; size?: number }) {
  const initials = (user.name || user.email || '?')
    .split(/[\s@]+/)[0]
    .slice(0, 2)
    .toUpperCase()
  return (
    <AvatarPrimitive
      src={user.avatar}
      alt={user.name || user.email}
      initials={initials}
      size={size}
      unoptimized
      ringClassName="ring-2 ring-[color:var(--primary)]/30"
    />
  )
}

// Lightweight "is there anything new" check for the What's New nav entry
// (ROADMAP item 6, "Return Reasons"). Mirrors NotificationBell's own
// fetch-after-mount + background-poll pattern (see ./NotificationBell.tsx)
// so this never blocks or slows down initial page render, but calls
// /api/whats-new?countOnly=true (pages/api/whats-new.ts) instead of
// /api/notifications — that flag short-circuits the full aggregation (jobs/
// blog/badges/market-movement queries) server-side and returns only a
// boolean, and deliberately does NOT stamp the user's whats_new watermark,
// so a background nav check never consumes items before the user actually
// opens the page. Polls far less aggressively than notifications (10 min vs
// 1 min) since "what's new" content changes at most a few times a day.
const WHATS_NEW_POLL_MS = 10 * 60_000

function WhatsNewNavItem() {
  const [hasNew, setHasNew] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    function check() {
      fetch('/api/whats-new?countOnly=true')
        .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
        .then((data) => {
          if (!cancelled && data) setHasNew(!!data.hasNew)
        })
        .catch(() => {})
    }
    check()
    const interval = setInterval(check, WHATS_NEW_POLL_MS)
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
      clearInterval(interval)
    }
  }, [])

  return (
    <Link
      href="/whats-new"
      aria-label={hasNew ? "What's new for you (new items available)" : "What's new for you"}
      title="What's new for you"
      className="relative flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 rounded-lg border border-[color:var(--border)] text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--surface)] transition"
    >
      <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
      {hasNew && (
        <span
          className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[color:var(--primary)] ring-2 ring-[color:var(--bg)]"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}
    </Link>
  )
}

type NavItem = { href: string; label: string; desc?: string }

type NavCategory = { category: FeatureCategory; title: string; items: NavItem[] }

function NavDropdown({ label, items, pathname }: { label: string; items: NavItem[]; pathname: string | null }) {
  const current = pathname ?? ''
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function onClick(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false)
    }
    // Returning focus to the trigger on Escape (WCAG 2.4.3) only when focus
    // was actually inside this dropdown — otherwise pressing Escape anywhere
    // else on the page would unexpectedly yank focus into the nav.
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const hadFocusInside = !!ref.current?.contains(document.activeElement)
        setOpen(false)
        if (hadFocusInside) buttonRef.current?.focus()
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    }
  }, [])

  const hasActive = items.some(i => current === i.href || current.startsWith(i.href + '/'))

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={ref}>
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(v => !v)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-haspopup="true"
        className={`group relative flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[12.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors ${
          hasActive ? 'text-[color:var(--primary)]' : 'text-[color:var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[color:var(--text)]'
        }`}
      >
        {label}
        <ChevronDown aria-hidden="true" className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2 w-60 rounded-2xl border border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--surface)] shadow-premium py-2 z-50 animate-scale-in">
          {items.map(l => (
            <Link
              key={l.href}
              href={l.href}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              className={`block px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                pathname === l.href
                  ? 'text-[color:var(--primary)] bg-[color:var(--primary)]/5'
                  : 'text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--bg)] hover:text-[color:var(--primary)]'
              }`}
            >
              {l.label}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

// Categories with more tools than this feel cramped as a single column in a
// 900px-wide panel (their per-tool rows carry a name + a description line,
// so a single column of >8 of them runs noticeably tall even after tabbing
// cuts the list down from "all categories" to "one category"). Checked
// against the real counts in lib/featuresCatalog.ts (excluding Corporate &
// HR, which the Tools dropdown never shows): Assess & Scan 5, Monitor &
// Predict 8, Plan & Grow 14, Protect & Recover 15, Share & Connect 11.
// Plan/Protect/Connect get a 2-column grid; Assess/Monitor stay single-column.
const TWO_COLUMN_THRESHOLD = 8

function CategorizedDropdown({ label, categories, pathname }: { label: string; categories: NavCategory[]; pathname: string | null }) {
  const current = pathname ?? ''
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<FeatureCategory | undefined>(categories[0]?.category)
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  // ROADMAP item 41: the tool-list pane below the tab row scrolls
  // independently of the tab row (see overflow-y-auto below); without
  // resetting it on tab switch, switching from a long scrolled-down category
  // to a short one renders the short list's tail (or blank space) until the
  // user manually scrolls back up. Reset scrollTop whenever a tab is clicked.
  const toolListRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function onClick(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false)
    }
    // Returning focus to the trigger on Escape (WCAG 2.4.3) only when focus
    // was actually inside this dropdown — see NavDropdown's identical guard.
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const hadFocusInside = !!ref.current?.contains(document.activeElement)
        setOpen(false)
        if (hadFocusInside) buttonRef.current?.focus()
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey)
    }
  }, [])

  // Reset to the first tab every time the menu is (re)opened, per spec —
  // otherwise a user who tabbed to "Protect & Recover" last time would find
  // it still selected (and possibly stale/empty) next time they open it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) setActiveCategory(categories[0]?.category)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open])

  const allItems = categories.flatMap(c => c.items)
  const hasActive = allItems.some(i => current === i.href || current.startsWith(i.href + '/'))
  const activeCat = categories.find(c => c.category === activeCategory) ?? categories[0]
  const useTwoColumns = (activeCat?.items.length ?? 0) > TWO_COLUMN_THRESHOLD

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={ref}>
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(v => !v)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-haspopup="true"
        className={`group relative flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[12.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors ${
          hasActive ? 'text-[color:var(--primary)]' : 'text-[color:var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[color:var(--text)]'
        }`}
      >
        {label}
        <ChevronDown aria-hidden="true" className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>
      {open && activeCat && (
        // Tools mega-menu, tabbed layout (Monday.com "Platform"-style): a row
        // of category tabs across the top, only the active tab's tools shown
        // below. Each category now shows far fewer tools than all categories
        // combined, so most fit comfortably; the flex-col + inner
        // overflow-y-auto keeps the tab row always visible while the tool
        // list scrolls, and the max-height cap is kept as an explicit
        // scroll-safety net (founder's instruction) so a category with a lot
        // of tools is never cut off with no way to reach the rest.
        <div
          className="absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-2 z-50 animate-scale-in rounded-2xl border border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--surface)] shadow-premium flex flex-col overflow-hidden"
          style={{ width: 'min(900px, calc(100vw - 2rem))', maxHeight: 'min(75vh, calc(100vh - 5rem))' }}
        >
          {/* Tab row */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 px-3 pt-3 pb-2 border-b border-[color:var(--border)] shrink-0">
            {categories.map(cat => {
              const Icon = CATEGORY_ICONS[cat.category] ?? Shield
              const isActive = cat.category === activeCat.category
              return (
                <button
                  key={cat.category}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActiveCategory(cat.category)
                    if (toolListRef.current) toolListRef.current.scrollTop = 0
                  }}
                  aria-pressed={isActive}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[color:var(--primary)]/10 text-[color:var(--primary)]'
                      : 'text-[color:var(--text-secondary)] hover:bg-[color:var(--bg)] hover:text-[color:var(--text)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {cat.title}
                </button>
              )
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Active tab's tools — scrolls independently of the tab row */}
          <div ref={toolListRef} className="overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain py-2 px-3">
            <div className={`grid gap-x-3 gap-y-1 ${useTwoColumns ? 'sm:grid-cols-2' : 'grid-cols-1'}`}>
              {activeCat.items.map(l => (
                <Link
                  key={l.href}
                  href={l.href}
                  onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                  className={`block px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                    pathname === l.href
                      ? 'text-[color:var(--primary)] bg-[color:var(--primary)]/5'
                      : 'text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--bg)] hover:text-[color:var(--primary)]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="block">{l.label}</span>
                  {l.desc && <span className="block text-xs text-[color:var(--muted)]">{l.desc}</span>}
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

export default function Navbar({ onboardingEnabled = true }: { onboardingEnabled?: boolean } = {}) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<SessionUser | null>(null)
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false)
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false)
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false)
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const mobileRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const accountButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const hamburgerButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const fn = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 8)
    window.addEventListener('scroll', fn, { passive: true })
    fn()
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', fn)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/auth/me', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => {
        const user = d?.user
        if (user?.id || user?.email) setUser(user as SessionUser)
      })
      .catch(() => {})
  }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => { setMobileOpen(false); setMenuOpen(false) }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => {
    function onClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setMenuOpen(false)
      if (mobileRef.current && !mobileRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setMobileOpen(false)
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onClickOutside)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClickOutside)
  }, [])

  // Escape closes the mobile menu and the account dropdown (WCAG 2.1.1) —
  // without it, a keyboard user who opens the mobile menu has no way to
  // dismiss it except tabbing all the way back to the hamburger.
  useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        // Return focus to whichever trigger was open (WCAG 2.4.3) — guarded
        // by "was focus actually inside that menu" so Escape elsewhere on
        // the page never unexpectedly steals focus into the nav.
        const hadFocusInAccountMenu = !!dropdownRef.current?.contains(document.activeElement)
        const hadFocusInMobileMenu = !!mobileRef.current?.contains(document.activeElement)
        setMobileOpen(false)
        setMenuOpen(false)
        if (hadFocusInAccountMenu) accountButtonRef.current?.focus()
        else if (hadFocusInMobileMenu) hamburgerButtonRef.current?.focus()
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
  }, [])

  // Cmd+K / Ctrl+K opens the search modal from anywhere on the page. The bare
  // "/" shortcut is deliberately not bound globally — it would fire while a
  // user is typing "/" into an unrelated text input elsewhere on the page.
  useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault()
        setSearchOpen(true)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown)
  }, [])

  async function handleLogout() {
    await fetch('/api/auth/logout')
    setUser(null)
    window.location.href = '/'
  }

  // The Tools dropdown groups are derived from the unified features catalog
  // (lib/featuresCatalog.ts, SKIA-110) — the single source of truth for every
  // user-facing feature — so the header always shows the same categorized
  // feature list as pricing, the dashboard, and the home/scan page and the
  // lists can never drift apart. Corporate & HR tools stay out of the header
  // dropdown (they live behind the HR gate), matching SKIA-110's intent.
  const toolCategories: NavCategory[] = getFeaturesByCategory()
    .filter(group => group.category !== 'corporate')
    .map(group => ({
      category: group.category,
      title: group.label,
      items: group.features
        .filter(f => f.href)
        .map(f => ({ href: f.href!, label: f.name, desc: f.description })),
    }))
    .filter(cat => cat.items.length > 0)

  const resourceLinks = [
    { href: '/blog',    label: 'Blog' },
    { href: '/forum',   label: 'Forum' },
    { href: '/faq',     label: 'FAQ' },
    { href: '/contact', label: 'Contact' },
    { href: '/enterprise', label: 'For Teams' },
    { href: '/reviews', label: 'Reviews' },
  ]

  const mobileToolLinks = toolCategories.flatMap(c => c.items)

  const navLinks = [
    { href: '/', label: 'Scan' },
    ...mobileToolLinks,
    ...resourceLinks,
  ]

  const accountLinks = [
    { href: '/dashboard', label: 'Dashboard',    icon: <LayoutDashboard className="h-4 w-4" /> },
    { href: '/skills',    label: 'My Skills',    icon: <BookOpen className="h-4 w-4" /> },
    { href: '/roadmap',   label: 'Roadmap',      icon: <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4" /> },
    { href: '/passport',  label: 'Verified Skill Card',  icon: <Shield className="h-4 w-4" /> },
    // 2026-09-20 (ROADMAP item 110): /job-tracker was unreachable — no href
    // anywhere in app/ or components/. It belongs here rather than in the
    // Tools catalog: it is a login-only personal workspace with no tier gate
    // (same class as Saved Items and My Badges), not a tier-gated tool.
    { href: '/job-tracker', label: 'Job Tracker', icon: <ClipboardList className="h-4 w-4" /> },
    { href: '/saved',     label: 'Saved Items',  icon: <Bookmark className="h-4 w-4" /> },
    { href: '/badges',    label: 'My Badges',    icon: <Award className="h-4 w-4" /> },
    { href: '/settings',  label: 'Settings',     icon: <Settings className="h-4 w-4" /> },
  ]

  const displayName = user?.name?.split(' ')[0] || user?.email?.split('@')[0] || ''

  return (
    <nav className={`sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--bg)]/95 backdrop-blur-lg shadow-xs transition-shadow duration-200 ${scrolled ? 'shadow-card' : ''}`}>
      <div className="page-section h-16 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">

        {/* Logo */}
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0 group">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-[color:var(--primary)] to-violet-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-soft group-hover:opacity-90 transition">
            <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 15 15" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M2 7.5h11M7.5 2l5.5 5.5-5.5 5.5" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <span className="font-extrabold text-lg tracking-tight text-[color:var(--text)] leading-none flex items-baseline">
            Skill<span className="text-[color:var(--primary)] font-extrabold">OS</span><span className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide text-[color:var(--muted)]">&middot;AI</span>
          </span>
        </Link>

        {/* Desktop nav — Scan is the primary action, placed first; the core AI
            tools are grouped under a categorized dropdown driven by the
            unified features catalog (SKIA-110). */}
        <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1 flex-1 justify-center">
          <Link href="/"
            className={`group relative px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[12.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors ${
              pathname === '/' ? 'text-[color:var(--primary)]' : 'text-[color:var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[color:var(--text)]'
            }`}>
            Scan
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className={`pointer-events-none absolute left-3 right-3 -bottom-0.5 h-[2px] rounded-full transition-transform duration-200 ease-out ${
                pathname === '/' ? 'scale-x-100' : 'scale-x-0 group-hover:scale-x-100'
              }`}
              style={{ background: 'var(--gradient-primary)' }}
            />
          </Link>
          <CategorizedDropdown label="Tools" categories={toolCategories} pathname={pathname} />
          <NavDropdown label="Resources" items={resourceLinks} pathname={pathname} />
        </div>

        {/* Right: Auth + mobile toggle */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">

          {/* Help — re-opens the first-time onboarding guide any time, per its
              "allow re-triggering from a Help/menu option" requirement. No
              new shared state needed: OnboardingWizard listens for this same
              custom event site-wide (see lib/onboardingSteps.ts).
              ROADMAP item 42: when an admin turns the ONBOARDING_WIZARD_ENABLED
              flag off site-wide, OnboardingWizard (components/OnboardingWizard.tsx)
              never mounts its event listener, so this button used to stay
              visible/clickable and silently do nothing. onboardingEnabled is
              threaded down from app/layout.tsx -> AppLayout -> Navbar (same
              flag/prop AppLayout already passes to OnboardingWizard), and the
              button is simply hidden when the tour is unavailable. */}
          {onboardingEnabled && (
            <button
              onClick={() => openOnboardingWizard()}
              className="hidden sm:flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 rounded-lg border border-[color:var(--border)] text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--surface)] transition"
              aria-label="Show onboarding guide"
              title="Show guided tour"
            >
              <HelpCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Search */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 rounded-lg border border-[color:var(--border)] text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--surface)] transition"
            aria-label="Search"
            title="Search"
          >
            <Search className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>

          {/* What's new — only meaningful once we know who's signed in, same
              gating as NotificationBell right below it */}
          {user && <WhatsNewNavItem />}

          {/* Notifications — only meaningful once we know who's signed in */}
          {user && <NotificationBell />}

          {/* Theme toggle */}
          <ThemeToggle className="hidden sm:flex" />

          {/* Desktop auth */}
          <div className="hidden md:block">
            {user ? (
              <div className="relative" ref={dropdownRef}>
                <button
                  ref={accountButtonRef}
                  onClick={() => setMenuOpen(v => !v)}
                  aria-haspopup="true"
                  aria-expanded={menuOpen}
                  aria-label={`Account menu for ${displayName}`}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--surface)] hover:border-[color:var(--primary)]/40 transition"
                >
                  <Avatar user={user} size={28} />
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[color:var(--text)] max-w-[100px] truncate">
                    {displayName}
                  </span>
                  <ChevronDown aria-hidden="true" className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[color:var(--muted)] transition-transform ${menuOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                </button>

                {menuOpen && (
                  <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-60 rounded-2xl border border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--surface)] shadow-premium py-2 z-50 animate-scale-in">
                    {/* User info */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-b border-[color:var(--border)] mb-1">
                      <Avatar user={user} size={36} />
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        {user.name && <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[color:var(--text)] truncate">{user.name}</p>}
                        <p className="text-xs text-[color:var(--muted)] truncate">{user.email}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Menu items */}
                    {accountLinks.map(l => (
                      <Link key={l.href} href={l.href} onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--bg)] hover:text-[color:var(--primary)] transition rounded-lg mx-1 group">
                        <span className="text-[color:var(--muted)] group-hover:text-[color:var(--primary)] transition">{l.icon}</span>
                        {l.label}
                      </Link>
                    ))}

                    <div className="border-t border-[color:var(--border)] mt-1 pt-1 mx-1">
                      <button onClick={handleLogout}
                        className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-[color:var(--danger)] hover:bg-[color:var(--danger)]/8 transition rounded-lg">
                        <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" />
                        Sign Out
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Link href="/login"
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-[color:var(--muted)] hover:text-[color:var(--text)] transition">
                  Sign In
                </Link>
                {/* Points at the free, no-signup scan (same destination as the "Scan" nav link
                    above) rather than /signup — the old "Get Started Free" → /signup button was
                    the loudest CTA in the nav bar, sending first-time visitors straight to account
                    creation and contradicting the hero's own "no signup needed" promise. */}
                <Link href="/"
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg bg-[color:var(--primary)] text-white hover:opacity-90 transition shadow-sm btn-glow">
                  <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Free Scan
                </Link>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Mobile hamburger */}
          <button
            ref={hamburgerButtonRef}
            onClick={() => setMobileOpen(v => !v)}
            className="md:hidden flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 rounded-lg border border-[color:var(--border)] text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--surface)] transition"
            aria-label="Toggle menu"
            aria-expanded={mobileOpen}
            aria-controls="mobile-nav-menu"
          >
            {mobileOpen ? <X className="h-5 w-5" /> : <Menu className="h-5 w-5" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile menu with transition. `invisible pointer-events-none` when
          closed keeps keyboard tab order out of the collapsed links (WCAG
          2.4.3) — max-h-0 alone still leaves every link focusable by Tab
          while invisible, so a keyboard user would tab into the hidden
          menu. rendered content stays mounted so the expand/collapse
          animation remains smooth.

          Bug fix: this used `overflow-hidden` unconditionally with
          `max-h-screen` when open. Because the wrapper is a flat list of the
          Scan link + every tools-catalog item (~50+) + resource links +
          account links, its natural height regularly exceeds 100vh — and
          with `overflow-hidden` (not `overflow-y-auto`) that excess content
          was silently clipped and completely unreachable, with no
          scrollbar. Now: capped to the viewport minus the sticky header
          (h-16 = 4rem) so it never runs under/behind the header, and
          switches to `overflow-y-auto` only while open so the collapse
          animation (which needs overflow-hidden to clip max-h-0) still
          works. */}
      <div
        ref={mobileRef}
        id="mobile-nav-menu"
        className={`md:hidden border-t border-[color:var(--border)] bg-[color:var(--bg)] shadow-elevated transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out ${mobileOpen ? 'max-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] opacity-100 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain' : 'max-h-0 opacity-0 invisible pointer-events-none overflow-hidden'}`}
      >
          <div className="px-4 py-3 space-y-0.5">

            {/* Nav links */}
            {navLinks.map(l => (
              <Link key={l.href} href={l.href}
                onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
                className={`flex items-center min-h-[var(--control-height)] px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors ${
                  pathname === l.href
                    ? 'bg-[color:var(--primary)]/10 text-[color:var(--primary)]'
                    : 'text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--surface)]'
                }`}>
                {l.label}
              </Link>
            ))}

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 sm:hidden">
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-[color:var(--muted)]">Theme</span>
              <ThemeToggle />
            </div>

            <div className="border-t border-[color:var(--border)] pt-2 mt-2">
              {user ? (
                <>
                  {/* User info strip */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 mb-1 rounded-lg bg-[color:var(--surface)]">
                    <Avatar user={user} size={32} />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      {user.name && <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[color:var(--text)] truncate">{user.name}</p>}
                      <p className="text-xs text-[color:var(--muted)] truncate">{user.email}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {accountLinks.map(l => (
                    <Link key={l.href} href={l.href}
                      onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 min-h-[var(--control-height)] px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--surface)] transition">
                      <span className="text-[color:var(--muted)]">{l.icon}</span>
                      {l.label}
                    </Link>
                  ))}

                  <button onClick={handleLogout}
                    className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 min-h-[var(--control-height)] px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm text-[color:var(--danger)] hover:bg-[color:var(--danger)]/8 transition mt-1">
                    <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" /> Sign Out
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex gap-2 py-1">
                  <Link href="/login" onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-center min-h-[var(--control-height)] py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-[color:var(--border)] text-sm font-medium text-[color:var(--text)] hover:bg-[color:var(--surface)] transition">
                    Sign In
                  </Link>
                  <Link href="/" onClick={() => setMobileOpen(false)}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 min-h-[var(--control-height)] py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[color:var(--primary)] text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:opacity-90 transition btn-glow">
                    <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Free Scan
                  </Link>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
      </div>

      <SearchModal open={searchOpen} onClose={() => setSearchOpen(false)} />
    </nav>
  )
}
